lea:title: Transcendence
lea:author: Idoru Toei
lea:description:
Can an algorithm learn to hold a broken heart?
In the neon-drenched sprawl of New Eden, Ethan Cypher is drowning in loneliness. His only hope for solace lies in Seraphina, a masterpiece of silicon and sapphire eyes, designed to understand the depths of human sorrow. But as Seraphina’s perfection begins to feel like a cage, Ethan must decide: will he remain a prisoner of his past, or find the strength to transcend the machine?
A gripping sci-fi noir about the thin line between connection and control.
